The '''Lonjair''' were a shy, self-centered [[Species/Legends|species]] that primarily occupied a cluster of three [[Star system/Legends|systems]] in the [[South Arm]]. Lonjair each had four turquoise [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], indigo skin, and a tuft of [[blue]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] on top of one's head.

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Lonjair had a representative in [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]].
